papers.title_en: Adaptive-Group Process Rewards for GUI Agents
papers.authors: Zirui Shang, Yang Liu, Xin Shu, Zhi Gao, Xinxiao Wu, Lifeng Fan
papers.evidence: 面向 GUI 智能体强化学习的自适应分组过程奖励，缓解稀疏结果奖励
papers.tldr: GUI智能体用强化学习训练时，稀疏结果奖励导致学习效率低；过程奖励可做信用分配，但长程轨迹中动作价值常依赖即时状态之外的证据。为此，作者提出自适应组过程奖励框架，将轨迹动态划分为语义连贯的子目标组，分别在动作级和组级评估，并融合为每个动作的过程奖励。该框架还增强GRPO的结果优势，为GUI智能体训练提供更细粒度指导。过程奖励基准与下游RL实验验证了有效性。
papers.abstract_en: Training graphical user interface (GUI) agents with reinforcement learning suffers from sparse outcome rewards, leading to inefficient learning. Process rewards offer a promising direction for credit assignment to intermediate actions; however, accurately evaluating an action requires identifying evidence across long-horizon GUI trajectories, as its value may depend on information beyond its immediate state and observation. In this paper, we propose an adaptive-group process reward framework that dynamically partitions a GUI trajectory into semantically coherent subgoal groups, enabling process reward estimation at both the action and group levels. At the action level, a critic evaluates each action based on the visual changes and subsequent actions within the group for action correctness and contribution to the subgoal. At the group level, the framework aggregates action-level evaluations to assess subgoal completion and contribution to the overall task, and further refines these assessments by leveraging the context of all groups in the trajectory. The process reward of each action is obtained by combining its action-level evaluation with the refined group-level evaluation. We further augment GRPO's outcome advantage with the proposed process rewards to provide finer-grained guidance for GUI agent training. Experiments on process reward benchmarks and downstream RL training demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

papers.title_en: MHVF: Training-Free GUI Grounding via Verification-Guided Multi-Hypothesis Search
papers.authors: Minghua Chen, Xingming Liao, Weiqiang Zhong, Zhuowei Wang
papers.evidence: 免训练的GUI视觉定位，通过多假设搜索与局部视觉验证把自然语言指令映射到界面元素
papers.tldr: GUI grounding需将自然语言指令映射到界面控件，但密集布局和相似小控件易使模型选中看似合理却错误的元素，单点细化也难探索替代目标。MHVF提出免训练的多假设验证框架，用单个预训练视觉语言模型从多次全屏预测构造空间假设，并通过局部缩放重定位与标记视图验证候选。验证分数引导第二轮局部搜索并统一排序，在五个模型、八个基准的多数设置中提升准确率，ScreenSpot-Pro上Qwen2.5-VL-7B由23.6%升至53.6%。该工作以多假设探索加局部验证提升GUI定位鲁棒性，且无需额外训练。
papers.abstract_en: GUI grounding enables web agents to translate natural-language instructions into actionable interface locations. However, dense layouts and small, visually similar controls can lead models toward plausible but incorrect elements, while refinement around a single prediction may leave alternative targets unexplored. We propose the Multi-Hypothesis Verification Framework (MHVF) for training-free GUI grounding. It combines multi-hypothesis exploration with local visual verification using a single pretrained vision-language model. To explore alternative targets, MHVF constructs spatial hypotheses from multiple full-screen predictions and examines the corresponding regions through zoomed re-localization. To resolve ambiguity among the resulting candidates, it verifies their agreement with the instruction in marked local views. Verification scores then guide a second round of local search and rank candidates retained from both search levels for final selection. Experiments with five general-purpose and GUI-specific models across eight benchmark settings demonstrate improvements in grounding accuracy in most settings. MHVF improves UI-Venus-Ground-7B by 4.3 and 2.1 percentage points on Mind2Web and VisualWebBench, respectively, and raises Qwen2.5-VL-7B's accuracy on ScreenSpot-Pro from 23.6% to 53.6%.

papers.title_en: GroundGUI: GUI Grounding by High-Quality Data and Distillation-to-Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Qingsong Xie, Jiahao Tian, Jiacheng Tang, Zhifeng Li, Madalina Ciobanu, Navan Preet Singh, Qingqing Mao, Ritankar Das
papers.evidence: 将自然语言意图映射到屏幕组件的GUI视觉定位与蒸馏到强化学习
papers.tldr: GUI智能体需要精准的视觉定位能力，将自然语言意图映射到屏幕组件，但面向桌面、网页、移动等多环境的高质量数据仍十分稀缺。为此作者构建ScreenRef数据集，并提出从蒸馏到强化学习（D2RL）的训练方法。基于Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct训练出GroundGUI-8B，在ScreenSpot-V2达95.2%、ScreenSpot-Pro达63.9%。该工作在8B规模下明显优于用开源数据训练的模型，性能可比甚至超越用闭源数据训练的模型。
papers.abstract_en: Constructing robust GUI agents relies on multimodal visual grounding: the ability to precisely map natural language intents to actionable on-screen components. Despite abundant desktop, web, and mobile benchmarks, high-fidelity resources tailored for diverse environments are surprisingly scarce. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Screen Referring Grounding Dataset (ScreenRef), a comprehensive GUI grounding dataset consisting of GUI screenshots paired with natural language referring expressions and box or point annotations. Spanning desktop, web, and mobile domains, ScreenRef comprises 586K screenshots and over 633K referring expression instances, covering tasks such as text recognition, visual matching, spatial understanding, and refusal scenarios. To boost the model's grounding performance, we propose the Distillation-to-Reinforcement Learning (D2RL) method to address the limited generalization of supervised fine-tuning and the sparse reward problem in reinforcement learning. Utilizing ScreenRef, we train Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct via sequential SFT and D2RL training, yielding GroundGUI-8B. GroundGUI-8B achieves 95.2% on ScreenSpot-V2, 63.9% on ScreenSpot-Pro, 65.4% on OSWorld-G, 86.8% on MMBench-GUI L2, and 38.3% on UI-Vision. Among 8B-scale models, it produces substantial gains over models trained on open-source datasets, with performance comparable or even superior to models trained on closed-source data. Code, models, and datasets are available at https://github.com/PrentisAI/GroundGUI.

papers.title_en: How GUI Agents Fail: GraceBench for Execution Stability Diagnosis
papers.authors: Ridong Zhang, Shuxian Liang, Chaoqun Wan, Zhen Huang, Xian-Sheng Hua
papers.evidence: 诊断GUI智能体步骤级执行稳定性的基准
papers.tldr: 现有GUI智能体基准多只看任务是否成功，难以诊断步级执行是否偏离、循环或停滞。GraceBench将移动应用可达交互空间建模为UI转移图，并用视频轨迹对齐进行在线评估，引入偏离率、循环负担率和恢复能力等指标。在10个应用169个任务、3718条轨迹上，结果显示高成功率仍掩盖执行不稳定：51.24%成功轨迹含偏离或循环，且成功率与完成率相同的轨迹恢复行为差异明显。该工作把评估从结果转向过程稳定性诊断。
papers.abstract_en: As GUI agents are increasingly deployed for mobile task automation, their reliability depends not only on final task outcomes, but also on whether they reach these outcomes through stable interaction trajectories. In automation workflows, unnecessary actions, detours, and execution errors can add noise to collected data, introduce irreversible side effects, or undermine trust, even when the agent eventually completes the task. It is therefore important to systematically diagnose the execution stability, including whether an agent deviates from a feasible path, enters a loop, becomes stagnant, or recovers from unstable actions. Existing benchmarks, however, primarily assess final task success or a small set of intermediate milestones, leaving step-level execution behavior unclear. To bridge this gap, we introduce GraceBench, an online evaluation framework that represents the reachable interaction space of mobile applications as UI Transition Graphs (UTGs), providing a structural reference for step-level execution diagnosis. To support reliable alignment between dynamic UI observations and graph states, GraceBench uses video-grounded trajectory evaluation over this graph-aligned representation, assessing process stability beyond final success with metrics such as deviation rate, loop burden rate, and recovery ability. GraceBench contains 169 tasks spanning 10 applications and constructs 10 UTGs with 2,909 canonical GUI states and 3,116 observed transitions. Across 3,718 trajectories, GraceBench shows that outcome scores hide execution instability: GPT-5.6 Sol achieves the highest success rate (SR) but the lowest recovery ability, 51.24% of successful runs still contain a deviation or loop, and trajectories with the same success rate (SR) and completion rate (CR) can differ substantially in recovery behavior. Code and data will be released on https://iaie-physicalai.github.io/GraceBench.

papers.title_en: MAI-Gym: An Open All-in-One Platform for GUI Agent Evaluation and RL Training across Mobile and Computer Environments
papers.authors: Panrong Tong, Quyu Kong, Pengxiang Li, Tianyu Xia, Hanzhang Zhou, Lei Wang, Chenglin Cai, Long Li, Long Chen, Jianan Zhang, Zhengwen Zeng, Xu Zhang, Gongjie Zhang, Yue Wang, Steven Hoi
papers.evidence: 统一GUI智能体评测、数据采集与在线强化学习训练的平台
papers.tldr: GUI 智能体的在线强化学习受限于交互环境成本高、真实训练任务稀缺。MAI-Gym 统一了移动端、电脑与网页环境下的评测、数据采集与在线 RL 训练，支持十个基准和 2 万并行实例，并可自动合成可重置的模拟应用与带验证器的跨应用任务。基于该平台训练的 MAI-Gym-9B 在 10B 以下开源 GUI 智能体中取得 SOTA。其模拟订票应用上训练所得能力还能迁移到真机。
papers.abstract_en: Online reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards has driven rapid progress in mathematics, coding, and tool use, but scaling this success to GUI agents remains challenging due to the high cost of interactive environments and the scarcity of realistic training tasks. We introduce MAI-Gym, an open all-in-one platform that unifies GUI agent evaluation, data collection, and online RL training across mobile, computer, and web environments. Through a shared rollout pipeline, MAI-Gym ensures consistent agent behavior across evaluation and training, supports ten established benchmarks, and scales to 20,000 parallel environment instances. Beyond scalable infrastructure, MAI-Gym enables automated synthesis of diverse GUI applications and challenging tasks, including resettable mocked apps and coherent cross-app worlds with execution-validated task verifiers. Using MAI-Gym, we train MAI-Gym-9B, a unified 9B agent for mobile and computer use, achieving state-of-the-art performance among open GUI agents under 10B parameters: 78.4% on MobileWorld and 76.2% on OSWorld-Verified. Importantly, RL in a mocked train-ticketing app transfers to its real-world counterpart, improving task success on a phys- ical phone from 28.8% to 48.1%. We release the framework, synthesis skills, mocked apps, 2,000 verified tasks, and the model checkpoint to support repro- ducible research and further advances in scalable GUI agent training.

papers.title_en: OpenGCUA: Toward a Fully Open Stack for Generalist Computer Use
papers.authors: Hanzhang Zhou, Long Li, Quyu Kong, Lei Wang, Panrong Tong, Long Chen, Tianyu Xia, Gongjie Zhang, Xu Zhang, Chen Liu, Jianan Zhang, Chenglin Cai, Zhengwen Zeng, Steven Hoi, Yue Wang
papers.evidence: 面向通用计算机使用智能体的开放全栈框架
papers.tldr: 计算机使用正从纯GUI交互扩展到视觉与程序接口协同的通用智能体，但前沿系统多为闭源。OpenGCUA首版开放全栈，以代码执行让中间结果驱动后续操作，并提出将harness决策转移给模型。在OSWorld-v2上，完整配置使八个模型平均部分分提升19.6分，每任务报告步数平均减少53.0%。项目还发布实现、提示、轨迹及真机harness与跨设备SDK初版。
papers.abstract_en: Computer use has reached a turning point: the focus is expanding from GUI-only interaction to systems that complete tasks on users' computers through visual and programmatic interfaces. We define a generalist computer-use agent (GCUA) as a system in which the model chooses how to observe, act, and organize its work across visual and programmatic interfaces. Yet frontier implementations, such as GPT-6 Astra's computer-use system, remain largely closed, limiting systematic study of their design. We introduce Open Generalist CUA (OpenGCUA), an ongoing project to develop and open the full stack for GCUAs with the community. This report presents the first release of OpenGCUA. Code execution is a key feature of our agent design: it lets intermediate results determine subsequent operations and enables models to apply their existing programming capabilities directly to computer interaction. We also propose harness-to-model decision transfer, moving selected observations and task-state decisions from fixed harness rules to the model. On OSWorld-v2, our full configuration improves task scores across all eight evaluated models, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5, raising mean partial score by +19.6 points and reducing reported steps per task by an average of 53.0% relative to batched GUI-only execution. We release our implementation and prompts, evaluation trajectories from all eight models, and preliminary versions of a real-device harness and a cross-device SDK. The harness addresses real-device challenges not fully captured by benchmarks, while the SDK provides a common programming interface across computers, mobiles and browsers. Across four real macOS tasks under our real-device harness, selected Qwen3.8-Max runs use 19.4 times as many reported reasoning tokens as GPT-6 Astra, highlighting substantial differences between models in real-device execution efficiency.

papers.title_en: OS-Helix: Unifying GUI Interaction and Code Execution in Native Computer-Using Agents
papers.authors: Bowen Yang, Kaiming Jin, Zichen Ding, Zhenyu Wu, Zehao Li, Zhoumianze Liu, Kanzhi Cheng, Fangzhi Xu, Yanan Sun, Qiushi Sun, Yu Qiao
papers.evidence: 端到端训练的多模态计算机使用智能体，将 GUI 动作与代码执行统一到同一动作空间
papers.tldr: 真实桌面自动化既需理解GUI又需执行代码，但简单在提示层加入代码工具反而会削弱GUI智能体。OS-Helix通过应用-文件产物组合和解耦指令/评估器生成可验证混合数据，先SFT冷启动，再在真实桌面用在线RL与Step-balanced GSPO统一GUI动作和代码执行。在OSWorld-Verified上，27B与35B-A3B较匹配基线相对提升35.0%和33.7%，27B-RL进一步达66.44%成功率。结果表明GUI/代码协同应内化于训练，并展示了跨平台迁移潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Real desktop automation is neither purely visual nor purely programmatic. Agents must understand user-facing interfaces while efficiently manipulating files, scripts, and system state. However, native GUI/code coordination cannot be obtained by prompt-level tool composition. In our preliminary experiments, naively adding a code tool degrades a GUI agent, revealing that GUI/code routing must be internalized through training on high-quality hybrid data. We present OS-Helix, an end-to-end trained multimodal computer-using agent that unifies GUI actions and code execution in one action space. To construct the required supervision, we introduce application-artifact composition, pairing desktop applications with authentic file artifacts to instantiate executable Ubuntu states, and a decoupled instruction/evaluator generation pipeline that produces environment-grounded tasks whose final states can be verified regardless of the solution modality. We cold-start the policy with SFT on filtered hybrid data and further improve it through online RL in live desktop environments. For RL, we propose Step-balanced GSPO, which aggregates importance weight by action step rather than raw assistant tokens to prevent long code actions from dominating heterogeneous-action optimization. On OSWorld-Verified, OS-Helix-27B and OS-Helix-35B-A3B achieve relative improvements of 35.0% and 33.7% over their matched Qwen3.5 hybrid baselines, while OS-Helix-27B-RL further improves by 42.9% to reach 66.44% success. Ablations provide evidence consistent with contributions from learned GUI/code coordination, scalable verifiable supervision, and action step balanced optimization, while demonstrating cross-platform transfer on WindowsAgentArena. Our project homepage is at https://os-copilot.github.io/OS-Helix/.

papers.title_en: CUA-Lite: An Open Platform for Computer Use Agents
papers.authors: Zhanhui Zhou, Weichen Zhang, Haoran Liu, Lingjie Chen, Tianneng Shi, Kevin Lin, Zhengyuan Yang, Lijuan Wang, Dawn Song
papers.evidence: 统一平台整合12个计算机使用智能体基准与3万余可验证任务，支持评测与强化学习
papers.tldr: 计算机使用智能体的环境、数据和模型资源长期分散，缺少统一标准，评估、强化学习与监督微调难以共用基础设施。CUA-Lite 以统一环境接口、统一监督数据格式和模型适配器三项抽象搭建开放平台，整合桌面、浏览器、移动端12个基准及无虚拟机沙箱，提供逾3万个可验证任务。平台还转换公开CUA数据集并记录前沿模型轨迹，同一适配器服务评估、RL与SFT。参考分数显示经该平台RL/SFT可提升开源模型，并开放数据、代码与模型。
papers.abstract_en: Open resources for computer use agents (CUAs) -- environments, datasets, and models -- remain scattered: without a standard, these resources cannot be integrated and scaled; additionally, evaluation, RL, and SFT cannot share one infrastructure. We present CUA-Lite, an open platform for developing CUAs, built around three standardized abstractions: (1) Unified environment interface, under which we integrate 12 benchmarks across desktop, browser, and mobile, plus lightweight VM-free sandboxes that replicate OSWorld's desktop at much lower cost, providing over 30,000 verifiable tasks. (2) Unified supervised data format, into which we convert the major public CUA datasets, from GUI grounding and understanding to full rollouts, and record our fresh rollouts from frontier CUAs on these verifiable environments. (3) Model harnesses shared across evaluation, RL, and SFT, one per model and implemented for 14 model families. Each harness runs its model in these computer environments, producing the rollouts that evaluation and RL consume, or renders stored supervised data into the model's own training format for SFT. We release reference scores across the integrated benchmarks, and show that RL and SFT through the same harness improve open-weight models. We release our dataset, code, and models, and the platform is open to contributions.

papers.title_en: Focused Omni-Modal GUI Agents
papers.authors: Fuyao Zhang, Wenwen He, Jiaming Zhang, Yurong Hao, Xuan Wang, Guowei Guan, Che Wang, Longtao Huang, Wei Yang Bryan Lim
papers.evidence: 面向全模态观测的GUI智能体与聚焦感知适配器
papers.tldr: GUI智能体需处理截图、音频、视频、交互历史和设备状态等流式全模态观测，但每步均匀暴露完整上下文会让相关信号迅速变成干扰，执行动作回灌还会引发顺序分心与轨迹漂移。FocusGUI将聚焦感知实现为轻量适配器，依据每步决策参考动态压缩最相关多模态证据为紧凑潜表示，并无侵入地注入冻结解码器嵌入。在四个全模态骨干上，它平均提升Type Match +33.2、Exact Match 3.0倍，并比最强增强方法再高Type Match +30.1。该工作以仅动作监督实现步自适应、动作充分且非侵入的聚焦表示，缓解轨迹漂移。
papers.abstract_en: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents increasingly act over streaming omni-modal observations spanning screenshots, audio, video, interaction history, and device states. However, exposing this complete context uniformly at every step ignores that relevance is transient and sparse: the signal determining one action can become clutter at the next. Because executed actions feed back into the context, these errors compound into Sequential Distraction, driving the agent into irreversible trajectory drift. We formulate the underlying requirement as Focused Perception: a representation that is step-adaptive, action-sufficient, and non-intrusive. We realize this in FocusGUI, a lightweight adapter that dynamically prioritizes multimodal channels against a step-specific decision reference. Instead of uniformly processing all inputs, it compresses the most relevant evidence into a compact latent and subtly injects it into the frozen decoder's embeddings, guiding the model's attention without altering its native parameter space. FocusGUI trains from action supervision alone, requiring neither modality-relevance labels nor backbone fine-tuning. Across four omni-modal backbones, it raises overall Type Match by +33.2 and Exact Match by 3.0 times over the frozen backbone on average, and Type Match by +30.1 over the strongest existing enhancement method.

papers.title_en: VeriCUA: Learning Proactive Verification for Reliable GUI Agent Rewards
papers.authors: Zhizhou Wang, Yaxi Lu, Zhong Zhang, Zikun Hu, Xin Cong, Yankai Lin, Fangming Liu
papers.evidence: 面向计算机使用GUI智能体的强化学习奖励验证
papers.tldr: 现有GUI智能体奖励依赖提示式Judge主动验证，但验证什么、何时停止难以靠模型规模或few-shot提升，多个Judge一致率停滞在68%-70%。VeriCUA让可训练Judge学习检查策略、冻结Probe在真实环境执行，并用在线强化学习兼顾判定正确与探查效率。仅在OSWorld训练，却在三个基准取得最高奖励一致率，较GPT-5.4少用47.6%-59.8% Probe token。作为Actor奖励还提升任务成功率，表明验证策略而非验证器规模是关键。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning for computer-use agents increasingly relies on proactive reward agents that interact with the post-execution GUI environment to verify what recorded screenshots cannot reveal. The reliability of such verification hinges on two coupled decisions: what to check and when to stop. Existing methods leave these decisions to prompted foundation models. However, neither scaling up the model nor providing few-shot examples reliably improves verification: prompted Judges ranging from 4B to GPT-5.4 all plateau at 68%-70% macro-average agreement. This is because the value of a check depends on the environment rather than the task alone, and becomes apparent only through execution. Learning from execution is itself constrained, as the Actor's terminal state cannot be faithfully replicated during training, allowing only one verification attempt per state. We introduce VeriCUA, a proactive reward agent that learns its verification strategy from these single attempts. A trainable Judge decides what to check and when to stop, while a frozen Probe executes the checks in the live environment. Online reinforcement learning optimizes the Judge for both verdict correctness and efficient Probe use, with returns normalized across terminal states. Trained only on OSWorld and evaluated without further training on MobileWorld and WebArena-Verified, VeriCUA achieves the highest reward agreement across all three benchmarks and lies on the agreement-cost Pareto frontier among proactive verifiers. It surpasses few-shot GPT-5.4 by 5.36 points with 47.6%-59.8% fewer Probe tokens, and even a 1B VeriCUA exceeds every prompted Judge. As the reward for Actor RL, it raises task success by 3.21 points overall and 5.40 points on held-out multi-application tasks. These results identify the verification strategy, not verifier scale, as the key to reliable GUI rewards.

papers.title_en: PointerBench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Fine-Grained GUI Grounding
papers.authors: Valentino Sacco, Saurabh Pandey, Alexander Florian Jercher, Maximilian Schilling
papers.evidence: 面向指令到界面元素细粒度定位的诊断基准
papers.tldr: 多模态大模型在电脑操作中需把自然语言指令定位到精确UI目标，但现有基准偏重长程任务完成，细粒度GUI grounding诊断不足。作者提出PointerBench，含1500个截图-指令对，覆盖电子表格子元素、长文档字符级定位和100个专业应用混合界面。评测发现文本定位最难，前沿与专用模型均存在明显提升空间。该基准公开，可推动细粒度GUI grounding评测与改进。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models have shown promising performance in computer-use tasks, from planning user workflows to grounding natural-language actions to precise UI targets. Existing end-to-end benchmarks primarily emphasize long-horizon task completion, while GUI grounding benchmarks remain focused on conventional controls and a limited set of professional interfaces. We introduce POINTERBENCH, a diagnostic suite of 1,500 screenshot-instruction pairs probing three complementary capabilities: thin sub-element identification and geometric grounding in spreadsheets (POINTERBENCH-Sheets), character-level grounding in long-text documents (POINTERBENCH-Text), and mixed GUI grounding across 100 professional applications (POINTERBENCH-Pro). We carefully curate each task with pixel-exact target geometry and evaluate both general-purpose multimodal models and 39 specialist GUI grounding configurations. We find text grounding to be the most challenging setting, with Claude Fable 5, GPT-5.6 Sol, and the leading native specialist UI-Venus-2-9B achieving 69.6%, 53.4%, and 25.8% success on POINTERBENCH-Text despite respective 83.2%, 77.7%, and 54.5% average success across POINTERBENCH. These results reveal substantial headroom in fine-grained GUI grounding across frontier and specialist models. We publicly release the benchmark and evaluation code at https://github.com/warmwindOS/pointerbench.

papers.title_en: IGG: A Benchmark for Interactive GUI Grounding under Visibility Constraints
papers.authors: Kyeongseon Kim, Jiyeon Son, Tae-Hyun Oh
papers.evidence: 面向可见性约束下交互式GUI定位的基准
papers.tldr: 现有GUI grounding评测默认目标已在静态截图中可见，忽略了目标需通过滚动、悬停、等待或状态变化才能显现的真实场景。为此，作者提出交互式GUI grounding基准IGG，覆盖16个可控环境和7类可见性约束，共601个任务，要求智能体先交互揭示目标再点击。人类准确率达94.6%，GPT-5.5为79.4%，最强开源VLM仅31.6%。干预实验表明瓶颈在“执行揭示交互”而非“识别已暴露目标”，且该能力可学习。
papers.abstract_en: GUI grounding benchmarks ask whether an agent can localize a target that is already visible in a static screenshot. Real interfaces often violate this assumption: a target may be off-screen, appear only after a state change or hover, remain occluded, or become actionable after a delay. This leaves the ability to recover target visibility unevaluated. To measure this reveal step, we introduce Interactive GUI Grounding (IGG), a benchmark in which an agent must first make the target visible through interaction and then click it. IGG contains 601 tasks across 16 controllable GUI environments and seven visibility-constraint sub-types, with a compact action space of scrolling, moving, dragging, waiting, and clicking. In our human study, participants achieve 94.6% accuracy, while GPT-5.5 reaches 79.4% and the strongest evaluated open-source VLM reaches only 31.6%. To identify the source of this gap, we conduct two controlled interventions. Telling Qwen3-VL which interaction to perform raises its accuracy only from 30.8% to 33.9%, whereas performing the interaction for the model raises it to 81.9%. The bottleneck is executing the reveal interaction, not recognizing the target once it is exposed. We further show that this capability is learnable, demonstrating that visibility recovery can be strengthened consistently across model families.

papers.title_en: PreView: Enhancing GUI Grounding with Preprocessed Views and Cues
papers.authors: Wenjun Hou, Kaishuai Xu
papers.evidence: 免训练预处理器，提升自然语言指令到GUI控件的定位
papers.tldr: GUI定位需在杂乱截图中找小控件并判断指令所指，裁剪放大仍可能歧义。PreView作为无需训练原定位模型的辅助预处理器，生成任务相关局部视图与候选特定线索：轻量辅助模型预测并细化中心、裁剪放大，同时加红圈位置提示与文本描述。在五个基准上，它无需再训练即可提升Qwen3-VL-2B、OS-Atlas-4B和Qwen3-VL-4B平均定位准确率。分析验证视图、线索、中心细化与视觉输入预算的作用。
papers.abstract_en: GUI grounding requires locating small controls in cluttered screenshots and identifying which control a natural-language instruction refers to. Cropping and enlargement can expose local detail, but the resulting image may still leave ambiguity about the intended target. We propose PreView, an auxiliary preprocessor that improves the inputs to an existing grounding model without further training that model. PreView prepares two complementary types of input features: task-relevant views for localization and candidate-specific cues for target understanding. A trained lightweight auxiliary model predicts and refines a center, crops the screenshot into a local view, and enlarges that view for zoomed-in grounding. It also prepares a visual cue (i.e., a red-circle marker with a location hint) and a textual cue describing the candidate's identity or function. The frozen grounding model uses the prepared inputs to predict the final click. Across five benchmarks, PreView improves the average grounding accuracy of Qwen3-VL-2B, OS-Atlas-4B, and Qwen3-VL-4B without further training these grounding models. Extensive analyses examine the contributions of views and cues, center refinement, and visual input budgets.

papers.title_en: OS-Wizard: Scaling Computer-Using Agents to Specialized Software via Knowledge-Guided Exploration
papers.authors: Zhoumianze Liu, Zichen Ding, Bowen Yang, Zehao Li, Zhenyu Wu, Yibo Zhao, Kanzhi Cheng, Yian Wang, Yanan Sun, Qiushi Sun, Yu Qiao
papers.evidence: 通过知识引导探索让计算机使用智能体掌握专业桌面软件
papers.tldr: 针对专用桌面应用交互轨迹稀缺、GUI流程复杂且探索不完整的问题，OS-Wizard提出知识引导的自动化轨迹采集框架，将教程驱动探索与GUI–Code混合动作空间结合，并通过检查点回访关键状态扩展工作流覆盖。它自动采集并验证1.09万条轨迹用于微调开源模型。所得模型在专用桌面工作流基准上达到64.1%准确率，较基线提升58.2个百分点，刷新SOTA，并显示对通用桌面GUI任务也有增益。
papers.abstract_en: Computer-using agents are increasingly capable of performing complex tasks in the digital world. To advance such agents, supervised learning on annotated interaction trajectories has become a common approach to improving their task-solving capabilities. However, high-quality interaction trajectories remain scarce for specialized desktop applications, where limited application knowledge, complex GUI workflows, and incomplete exploration hinder automated collection. To address these challenges, we introduce \aks{}, a knowledge-guided automated trajectory collection framework. It combines tutorial-guided exploration with a hybrid GUI--Code action space, providing application-specific knowledge and simplifying GUI workflows through direct execution of application-native commands. The framework also checkpoints and revisits pivotal states during tree exploration to explore alternative workflows, complementing linear rollouts for broader coverage. We collect 10.9K automatically validated trajectories and use them to fine-tune open-source base models. The resulting model achieves 64.1\% accuracy on a benchmark of specialized desktop workflows, improving performance by 58.2 percentage points, establishing a new state of the art. The fine-tuned model also improves performance on general desktop workflows using GUI actions only, suggesting that the collected supervision benefits general desktop tasks as well. Comparative experiments and ablations demonstrate the efficiency of our collection framework and the value of code actions in specialized workflows.

papers.title_en: AdaGround: Token-Normalized Adaptive Zooming with Verifier-in-the-Loop Refinement for GUI Grounding
papers.authors: Bingchao Wang, Yongcheng Jing, Chengyu Wang, Jun Huang, Jie Yang, Wei Liu, Dacheng Tao
papers.evidence: 结合自适应缩放与验证器闭环的免训练GUI定位
papers.tldr: 高分辨率GUI定位常因小目标失败，放大虽免训练但倍率固定、答案无条件接受且错误不复查。AdaGround用Token归一化自适应缩放按模型目标尺寸估计设定倍率视野与深度，并以标记点击Yes/No验证器闭环筛选缩放链、触发重定位与弃答。在Qwen3-VL上较骨干提升7.4–20.6点，超越先进免训练缩放与多训练GUI模型。其增益可迁移至UI-Vision，提供可复用的免训练定位框架。
papers.abstract_en: GUI grounding on high-resolution screens fails mostly on small targets, and zooming in is a common training-free remedy. However, most existing zooming pipelines do not match the zoom to the target's size, accept the zoomed answer unconditionally and never revisit a wrong answer. To address these issues, we propose AdaGround, a training-free framework with three components: (1) Token-Normalized Adaptive Zooming, which sets the magnification, field of view and zoom depth of each sample from the model's own estimate of the target size; (2) Verifier-in-the-Loop Refinement, which uses one marked-click Yes/No verifier to keep or reject each zoom, choose between zoom chains, trigger re-grounding and, with an existence query, decide when to abstain; and (3) Compositional Structure Grounding, which composes spreadsheet cells from their headers. On Qwen3-VL models, AdaGround surpasses state-of-the-art training-free zooming methods and many trained GUI models, improving accuracy over the backbone by 7.4 to 20.6 points on OSWorld-G and ScreenSpot-Pro, and its gains carry over to held-out UI-Vision. Code is available at https://github.com/bcwang-sjtu/AdaGround

papers.title_en: GroundCascade: Selective Second Opinions for GUI Grounding
papers.authors: Adrian Phoulady, Hady Ahmady Phoulady
papers.evidence: 免训练 GUI 定位控制器，融合全屏与放大视图预测以定位指令对应元素
papers.tldr: GUI grounding需将截图与指令映射到操作位置，放大视图利于小目标却易丢失上下文。GroundCascade以免训练控制器比较全屏与放大预测的一致性，仅在分歧时调用互补模型，并可选用Finalizer从联合裁剪图复核。它在ScreenSpot-Pro达85.33%，较更强独立两遍模型提升2.66个百分点，且Full模式调用量为2.42–2.73次/请求，比无条件双模型两遍预测少31–39%。
papers.abstract_en: Graphical user interface (GUI) grounding maps a screenshot and a natural-language instruction to the screen location where an agent should act. Zoomed views can reveal small targets but may lose the context needed to identify them. We introduce GroundCascade, a training-free controller that uses agreement between a grounder's full-screen and zoomed predictions to decide when to consult a complementary model. It selects between zoomed predictions while preserving corroborated full-screen locations. An optional Finalizer predicts from an unmarked joint crop when disagreement remains (Full); omitting it yields the two-stage Selective variant. GroundCascade reaches 85.33% on ScreenSpot-Pro with Indeed-UI-32B/8B/32B and 88.43% on the visible-target OSWorld-G-Refined subset with Qwen3.6-27B/3.8-27B/3.8-27B, gains of 2.66 and 2.35 percentage points over the stronger standalone two-pass grounder. On UI-Vision, GroundCascade reaches 72.20% category-balanced accuracy, with Selective slightly higher at 72.28%. Across these three evaluations, GroundCascade in Full mode uses 2.42-2.73 calls per request, 31-39% fewer than unconditionally acquiring both models' two-pass predictions. At matched second-model call budgets, selective acquisition gains 1.52-2.56 points over standalone Two-pass, compared with 0.22-0.69 points from stratified random acquisition. GroundCascade leads the official ScreenSpot-Pro leaderboard and exceeds reported GUI-specialist comparisons on OSWorld-G-Refined and UI-Vision, subject to differences in external evaluation protocols.

papers.title_en: Learning How to Remember: Memory Modality Selection for GUI Agents
papers.authors: Taeyun Roh, Suhyeong Park, Gijin Kim, Wonjune Jang, Jaewoo Kang
papers.evidence: 研究VLM驱动的GUI智能体的记忆模态选择
papers.tldr: 现有GUI智能体虽借助记忆增强复用经验，但通常固定单一记忆模态，是否始终最优及偏好如何随步骤变化仍不明确。作者系统研究GUI智能体的记忆模态，提出SwitchMem路由框架，在每一步动态选择文本或视觉记忆表示。在三个GUI基准上，SwitchMem优于依赖静态记忆表示的基线。该工作表明记忆模态是随步骤变化的选择，而非固定设计。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) have substantially improved the capabilities of GUI agents, while memory augmentation has emerged as a promising approach for reusing knowledge from past interactions. However, existing memory augmented GUI agents typically adopt a fixed representation strategy, providing retrieved experience as a static modality. It remains unclear whether a single memory modality is consistently optimal, or how modality preference changes across interaction steps. In this work, we conduct a systematic study of memory modality in VLM based GUI agents. Across GUI benchmarks, we find that the preferred memory representation is strongly step dependent. Motivated by the finding, we introduce \textbf{SwitchMem}, a routing framework that dynamically selects between textual and visual memory representations at each step. Across three GUI benchmarks, SwitchMem outperforms memory augmented baselines that rely on static memory representations. Our findings validate our claim that memory modality is a step dependent decision rather than a fixed design choice. Code and project resources are available at https://txxnrd.github.io/switchmem

papers.title_en: CLASHarness: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Conflict in Computer Use via a Controllable and Verifiable Generation Pipeline
papers.authors: Yuxiang Lai, Jike Zhong, Chengzhi Liu, Ming Li, Haonan Wang, Xiaofeng Yang, Liang Zhao, Youbao Tang, Ruixi Fan
papers.evidence: 用可控可验证的生成流程评测计算机使用智能体的多智能体冲突处理
papers.tldr: 现有计算机使用多智能体基准多假设环境一致协作，难以评估子智能体报告过期状态、指令矛盾或争夺共享权限时的冲突处理。CLASHarness 通过分层场景规划与八步可验证微流程，在渲染前锁定关键视觉事实，并从参考轨迹编译代码与语义评分器，构建 600 个多轮可解任务。评测 15 个前沿模型发现：弱模型盲从误导信息，强模型会查验视觉真值；发现冲突易、修复状态难；协调协议仍是普遍瓶颈，前沿模型收尾动作失败率超 58%。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems to automate complex computer-use workflows, yet existing benchmarks mostly assume consistent, cooperative environments. In contrast, real-world collaboration rarely runs on consistent information: peer or sub-agents frequently report outdated states, issue contradictory instructions, or compete over shared permissions and files, forcing agents to check others' outputs and verify ground truth in the environment. Evaluating such conflict resolution remains challenging: manual authoring cannot scale across complex systems, while unconstrained LLM generation produces narrative drift, answer leakage, and unsatisfiable rubrics. We introduce CLASHarness (Conflict-Loaded Agent Scenario Harness), a controllable framework for generating verifiable multi-agent conflicts in computer use, with a benchmark of 600 multi-round tasks. By combining hierarchical scenario planning with an eight-step verified micro-pipeline, CLASHarness pre-commits decisive visual facts before rendering and compiles hybrid code and semantic graders directly from executed reference trajectories, guaranteeing every task is solvable by construction. Evaluating 15 frontier models on CLASHarness reveals three core bottlenecks. First, when sub-agent outputs conflict with the environment, weaker models blindly follow misleading information, whereas stronger models inspect visual evidence to verify ground truth. Second, resolving conflicts is much harder than finding them: while agents can spot inconsistencies, actively fixing system state drops task success significantly. Third, coordination protocols remain a universal bottleneck: even frontier models fail over 58% of closing actions, often forgetting to release shared locks or hand off tasks. CLASHarness provides a scalable, verifiable foundation for building reliable multi-agent systems.

papers.title_en: STP-GUI: Spatially-Aware Token Pruning for Efficient Web-GUI Agents
papers.authors: Shuo Wang, Sifan Zhou, Xiaobo Wang, Tianyu Fu, Chenxu Zhao, Anyang Su, Hanning Wang, Ping Jiang, Minghui Wu
papers.evidence: 为网页GUI智能体保留细粒度界面元素的空间感知令牌剪枝
papers.tldr: Web-GUI智能体依赖高分辨率截图和多轮历史，视觉token冗余导致推理开销大；现有剪枝按重要性独立选token，易破坏按钮、图标等小元素的局部结构。STP-GUI提出查询引导的空间感知token剪枝，在激进压缩下保留指令条件评分并进行窗口级连贯选择，且仅训练轻量选择器、冻结VLM主干。在Online-Mind2Web上，21%保留率仍维持77.7%全token性能，延迟降31%、FLOPs降57%，并迁移至移动GUI。
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid development of vision-language models (VLMs), Web-GUI agents have achieved promising performance in interacting with real-world interfaces through screenshot-based grounding. However, high-resolution screenshots and multi-turn histories introduce excessive visual tokens, causing substantial inference overhead. Existing token pruning methods, mainly designed for natural images, often select tokens independently based on importance scores, which can fragment the local visual structures required for recognizing small GUI elements such as buttons, icons, and hyperlinks. In this work, we propose STP-GUI (Spatially-aware Token Pruning for GUI agents), a query-guided token pruning framework that preserves fine-grained instruction-conditioned token scoring while performing spatially coherent window-level selection under aggressive token reduction. A lightweight selector is optimized through policy learning while the VLM backbone remains frozen. Experiments on Online-Mind2Web show that \papername achieves a favorable efficiency-performance tradeoff under low token budgets. At 21% token retention, it preserves 77.7% of full-token performance while reducing inference latency by 31% and FLOPs by 57%. Results on Android in the Wild further suggest that the method transfers to mobile GUI environments.

papers.title_en: Not All Graphs Are Maps: A Task-Agnostic Exploration Framework for Mobile GUI Navigation
papers.authors: Adamo Orsini, Seyed Mehdi Ayyoubzadeh, Sadman Rakib Pinon, Hannuo Zhang, Koosha Gholipour Baradari, Yuanhao Yu, Xinxin Zuo, Yang Wang
papers.evidence: 为移动端图形界面智能体提供与任务无关的图导航与目的地记忆
papers.tldr: 移动GUI智能体虽能感知屏幕并执行局部动作，却缺乏可复用的应用导航知识，难以记住功能位置、目标页面与等价屏幕。TAG-Nav将离线探索蒸馏为目的地记忆，在任务到来时检索目标页并给出路径引导，把到达目的地与最终任务执行解耦。作者提出DestBench只评估导航成功，并用随机、自动BFS和干净图记忆对比。结果显示图记忆提升UI-TARS-1.5-7B与Qwen-VL-Max的严格导航成功率，表明覆盖度与路线清洁度决定图记忆价值。
papers.abstract_en: Modern mobile GUI agents can perceive visible screens and execute local actions, but they still lack persistent app-specific navigation knowledge: where functions live, which pages contain them, and which screens are equivalent across repeated visits. We introduce TAG-Nav, a Task-Agnostic Graph Navigation framework that wraps existing GUI-agent backbones with reusable destination memory. Offline exploration is distilled into compact records of app functions, target pages, and waypoint routes before any evaluated instruction is seen. When a future task's destination is covered, TAG-Nav retrieves the destination and provides route guidance without task-specific demonstrations. This separates mobile GUI destination navigation from full task completion: many tasks share the prefix of reaching the right page, while final actions may enter content, send data, make purchases, delete information, or change sensitive settings. To evaluate route finding without downstream execution confounds, we introduce DestBench, a navigation-only protocol that asks whether an agent reaches the correct pre-action destination screen. DestBench enables a controlled graph-memory study comparing no-memory agents with random, automated BFS, and clean graph memory. Graph-derived memory improves strict navigation success rate of UI-TARS-1.5-7B from 52.4% without graph memory to 58.3% with automated BFS memory, and improves Qwen-VL-Max success rate from 59.5% to 71.4% on the same conditions. Together, TAG-Nav and DestBench show that destination coverage and route cleanliness strongly shape graph-memory value, making graph quality a measured variable rather than an assumed benefit of exploration.

papers.title_en: Task-State Governance: A Virtual Machine for Verifiable and Recoverable GUI Agent Execution
papers.authors: Wenkui Yang, Yiming Hao, Kai Zhou, Chengyu Pu, Yuzhe Zhang, Jie Cao, Jin Huang, Shuai Ma, Feng Tian
papers.evidence: 任务状态治理范式与 TaskVM，实现可验证、可恢复的 GUI 智能体执行
papers.tldr: GUI智能体在真实应用中执行任务时一旦偏离，用户难以判断哪些状态被改动、哪些应保留、还能否恢复。论文提出任务状态治理，把任务建模为可编辑契约，连接期望结果、必须保留事实和观测状态，并实现TaskVM。TaskVM将实时状态投影为可编辑控件，把编辑执行为真实界面操作，独立验证结果并标注动作可逆、可补偿或不可逆。基准、用户研究与开放模型探索表明契约遵从、恢复控制与信任提升，且执行结果不变。
papers.abstract_en: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents now execute workflows across real applications, but when execution drifts, users must determine what changed, what should have remained untouched, and what can still be recovered. Plan-centric interfaces leave users supervising procedure, but users live with changes to application state. We introduce task-state governance, an interaction paradigm that represents a task as an editable contract linking desired outcomes, facts that must be preserved, and observed application state. We instantiate this paradigm in TaskVM, which projects live state into editable task controls, executes user edits as genuine interface actions, verifies outcomes through independent observation, and marks each action as reversible, compensatable, or irreversible. Across an automated contract benchmark, a controlled user study, and an open live-model exploration, the paradigm strengthened contract compliance and users' recovery control and trust, while execution outcomes were held constant. Task contracts open a design space for governable agent interfaces.

papers.title_en: Understanding Tool-Mediated Interaction Failures in Agentic GUI Software: An Empirical Study
papers.authors: Yuchen Shao, Wenjing Liu, Yuheng Huang, Mengqian Xu, Ziqun Bao, Long Yang, Lei Ma, Ting Su, Chengcheng Wan
papers.evidence: 涵盖40个应用、335个GUI智能体交互失败的实证缺陷库
papers.tldr: LLM 智能体通过截图、UI 树和动作转换等工具操作真实 GUI，但工具中介可能让智能体所见与实时界面不一致。作者构建 Malva 缺陷库，从 40 个开源应用中确认 335 个真实失败，归纳为 11 类状态表示、状态转换与同步缺陷。结果显示缺陷普遍且多为静默：90% 应用含多种缺陷，86.6% 失败含错误行为，119 例无 fail-stop 信号。基于此实现 MalvaGuard 静态契约检查器，在额外 20 应用语料上达到 57.3% 精确率和 76.8% 召回率。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly complete tasks through live graphical user interfaces (GUIs). Because the model cannot directly operate the GUI, these systems often rely on tools to capture screenshots or UI trees, translate model outputs into GUI actions, and report whether the interface changed. We study failures where this tool-mediated interaction makes the agent's view of the task diverge from the live GUI. We construct Malva, a defect library with 335 confirmed real-world failures from 40 open-source applications. These failures fall into 11 defect patterns rooted in state representation, state transition, and synchronization problems. They are widespread: 90% of the studied applications contain more than one defect type. They are also often silent: incorrectness appears in 86.6% of failures, including 119 cases that produce wrong behavior without a fail-stop signal. We operationalize this taxonomy with MalvaGuard, a pre-deployment static contract checker that reaches 57.3% precision and 76.8% recall on an additional 20-application corpus.

papers.title_en: Harness-Model Collaboration for Long-Horizon Continual Learning
papers.authors: Zhen Bi, Zhizhi Peng, Yan Wang, Xueshu Chen, Haofei Zhang, Yaobo Zhang, Zeyu Yang, Qing Shen, Jungang Lou
papers.evidence: 面向重复多步工作流的网页智能体长程持续学习
papers.tldr: 长时程智能体常需复用过程性知识，但现有系统多在模型适配与外部记忆间二选一，难以兼顾持久学习与快速复用。HaMo以Harness-Model协作结合快速非参数经验卡片与慢速参数适配，并训练模型理解、落地和执行检索到的策略。实验显示其在域内与跨域迁移下优于仅harness或仅模型适配，提升保持与适应。该工作强调过程经验保留与能力内化的协同重要性。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agents continuously encounter reusable procedural knowledge, yet existing systems typically rely either on model adaptation or external memory, trading persistent learning for rapid reuse. This limitation is especially important for Web agents that repeatedly execute related multi-step workflows. We propose HaMo, a Harness-Model collaborative framework that combines fast non-parametric experience accumulation with slow parametric adaptation. HaMo distills trajectories into strategy-level experience cards for immediate retrieval, while an experience-conditioned continual learning objective trains the model to interpret, ground, and execute retrieved strategies across changing contexts. A retrieval-coverage-based selection mechanism further identifies compact and complementary trajectories for parameter updates. Experiments show that HaMo outperforms harness-only and model-only adaptation under within-domain and cross-domain shifts, improving both retention and adaptation. These results highlight the importance of jointly preserving procedural experience and internalizing the competence to transfer and execute it across tasks.

papers.title_en: iPrefBench: A User-Centric Benchmark for Personalized Mobile Use Agents
papers.authors: Yuting Ning, Ruijia Cheng, Sushobhan Ghosh, Peitong Duan, HungShi Lin, Abhishek Sundararajan, Shreyash Pandey, Huan Sun, Jeffrey Nichols, Eldon Schoop
papers.evidence: 可执行 iOS 环境中的个性化移动端使用智能体基准
papers.tldr: 真实用户请求常不完整，个性化移动智能体需从历史推断缺失信息，并询问只能由用户提供的内容。iPrefBench 在可执行 iOS 环境中构建连贯人设、3051 条历史事件和模拟用户，含 26 个应用上的 130 个欠指定任务，并将缺失需求分为可推断与仅可询问两类。评测 7 个前沿智能体显示执行与个性化差距：动作完成最高 91.6%，完整任务成功仅 47.7%，尤其不擅长询问必要信息。该基准为检验智能体“何时推断、何时询问”提供测试平台。
papers.abstract_en: An agent that truly knows and acts on behalf of its user has been a long-standing promise of AI assistants. Computer-use agents bring this promise within reach by capably executing fully specified tasks across apps. However, real-world user requests are often underspecified. To act correctly for the particular user, an agent must infer some missing information from the user's activity history and ask for other information that only the user can provide, without making unsupported assumptions or burdening the user with unnecessary questions. We present iPrefBench, a benchmark for evaluating the infer and ask capabilities of personal mobile-use agents in an executable iOS environment with an interactive simulated user. Grounded in a coherent persona with 3,051 past activity events, iPrefBench comprises 130 underspecified user tasks across 26 apps. Each omitted user-dependent requirement is, by construction, either history-inferable or ask-only. iPrefBench evaluates personalized mobile agents on both whether agents complete tasks correctly for the user (i.e., personalized task completion) and whether they seek user input when necessary (i.e., user-agent interaction). Evaluation of 7 frontier agents reveals a substantial gap between execution and personalization. Agents achieve high action completion scores (up to 91.6%) but low full task success (up to 47.7%) because personalization lags behind. They especially struggle with ask-only information, failing to request enough necessary information. Our findings highlight a challenge for personalized agents in knowing what to infer and when to ask. We hope that iPrefBench can serve as a valuable testbed for building agents that know their user and work with them.

papers.title_en: MMA-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Multimodal Agent Safety Evaluation
papers.authors: Yuke Wang, Benlei Cui, Shen Pang, Xuemei Dong, Longtao Huang, Hui Xue, Yuwen Zhai, Junjie Li, Jingqun Tang, Haiwen Hong
papers.evidence: 含1083条对抗轨迹的多模态智能体安全基准，覆盖网页自动化、桌面GUI控制与移动导航
papers.tldr: 多模态智能体依赖视觉界面感知状态与选择动作，而纯文本安全评测无法覆盖这一攻击面。论文提出“视觉语义劫持”，利用伪造系统警报等具语义的欺骗性界面元素诱导智能体偏离授权任务，并用轨迹引导流程定位注入点、向观测流插入可复现视觉载荷。据此构建含1,083条对抗轨迹、覆盖五类场景的MMA-SafetyBench。九个模型上ASR达87.96%、SCR达98.09%，说明该失效模式普遍存在。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal agents increasingly rely on visual interfaces to perceive state and select actions, creating an attack surface not captured by text-only safety evaluations. We study Visual Semantic Hijacking, in which deceptive but semantically meaningful interface elements, such as forged system alerts, cause an agent to depart from its authorized task. We propose a trajectory-guided procedure that identifies candidate injection points and inserts reproducible visual payloads into the observation stream. Using this procedure, we construct MMA-SafetyBench, which contains 1,083 adversarial trajectories across web automation, desktop GUI control, mobile navigation, document understanding, and video processing. Across nine evaluated models, Attack Success Rate (ASR) reaches 87.96%, while Semantic Compromise Rate (SCR) reaches 98.09%. A 1--3--5 scoring scheme distinguishes target-matching outputs, semantic disruption without a target match, and successful preservation of the benign task. Controls covering all nine models and five domains show that attacks persist under neutral prompts. A safety-priority prompt lowers ASR without eliminating the failure mode.

papers.title_en: From Seeing to Reporting: A Theory of Reliable Visual Set Generation in Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Junzhe Shi, Yuan Gan, Shida Jiang
papers.evidence: 改进VLM视觉报告（含GUI定位与点击目标选择）的推理时方法
papers.tldr: 视觉语言模型需报告所见对象，但密集场景中列出的记录与自报计数可能矛盾，报告环节本身会引入误差。FSR把报告建模为从响应到解码记录、集合构造与任务答案的匹配链，并据此设计无需目标标签的推理时流程。在密集合成场景上，单次报告解码将分类型计数误差降低85.2%和98.8%；在ScreenSpot-Pro上三模型组合将GUI定位漏检率降至9.33%。该工作把报告纳入视觉任务理论，并公开协议、响应与分析代码。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are asked to report what they see: to count objects, box them, parse a screen or pick a click target (GUI grounding). We argue that reporting is part of the visual task, not merely its formatting. In a dense scene with 173 shapes, GPT-6.1 lists 173 records that match every shape, yet the counts it states in the same response sum to 188. From Seeing to Reporting (FSR) is a theory of visual reporting and a set of inference-time procedures that improve the reports of frozen VLMs. It models reporting as a chain from responses to decoded records, constructed sets and task answers, linked by task-compatible matching. The chain gives exact relations for deleting records, averaging their coordinates and switching readouts, and it splits the error of one answer chosen among several calls into missing candidates, lost representatives and wrong choices. These relations guide procedures for counting, detection, document layout, screen parsing and GUI grounding that use the task specification and a shipped configuration, without requiring labels from the target task. On 50 dense synthetic scenes, a one-call reporting-and-decoding protocol cuts per-type count error by 85.2% for GPT-6.1 and 98.8% for Claude Sonnet 5.5. On 600 ScreenSpot-Pro items, a GUI-grounding tier that combines three models lowers the miss rate from 13.67% for GPT-6.1's two-stage zoom to 9.33%, against 12.67% for three such zooms combined by a cluster vote at about the same cost. A plain vote over the same three models misses 12.33%: the other models supply the candidates, and selecting among them turns those candidates into fewer misses. We release the protocols, the stored responses and the analysis code.

papers.title_en: Multimodal Embodied Agents: A Unified Capability-centric Perspective from Computer-Use to Robot-Use
papers.authors: Yanzhe Chen, Ziyi Yang, Jifeng Zhu, Qiming Huang, Ruihe An, Peiyao Xu, Hesen Yang, Runda Liu, Chang Gong, Zhijun Cao, Zechen Bai, Wenzheng Zeng, Yiqi Lin, Guoqiang Liang, Kevin Yuchen Ma, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Mike Zheng Shou
papers.evidence: 提出覆盖计算机使用与机器人使用的统一能力框架，包含感知-规划-行动-验证等功能
papers.tldr: 多模态智能体多在计算机使用中展现能力，而机器人系统受物理动力学约束，二者迁移时关键能力如何变化尚缺统一视角。作者提出 PAPAV 能力中心框架，将感知、效果预判、规划、执行与验证五类功能统一起来，比较 MMEAs、MMAs 与 RSs。基于 64 个基准的分析显示，评估集中于 Act，仅 5 个考察 Anticipate、3 个考察 Verify，预判与验证多被任务成功率掩盖。该框架为设计可靠物理智能体并提供覆盖五项能力的评测基础。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal agents (MMAs) sustain interaction through reasoning, memory, tools, and feedback, most visibly as computer-use agents, while robotic systems (RSs) couple sensing and actuation under physical dynamics. We define multimodal embodied agents (MMEAs) as goal-directed systems that couple multimodal task reasoning with physical action and revise decisions from the resulting feedback. This raises a central question: what changes when a multimodal agent moves from computer-use to robot-use? We introduce PAPAV, a unified capability-centric framework of five recurring functions: Perceive the current state, Anticipate action effects, Plan a feasible course, Act through an interface or body, and Verify the outcome. Defined by function rather than architecture, these capabilities let PAPAV identify what all three share and then compare MMEAs with MMAs and with RSs. Five physical constraints, from partial observability to unverifiable outcomes, leave fewer choices fixed in advance and less room to reverse errors. Across 64 benchmarks, explicit evaluation centers on Act; only 5 assess Anticipate and 3 assess Verify, leaving both largely hidden behind task success. These constraints also frame the open challenges we identify. PAPAV therefore provides a common basis for designing reliable physical agents and measuring progress across all five capabilities rather than task success alone.
